releaseNotes:
Official Release v1.3.144:
- STRICT BIOMETRIC IDENTIFICATION: Removed false fallback matching that assigned unregistered fingerprints to first enrolled employee. Unrecognized fingerprints now properly report 'Not Recognized'.
- STATION SETUP WIZARD ON FRESH INSTALLS: Fresh installations on new computers automatically display the station setup wizard, allowing instant pairing as Secondary Register (Caja 2, Caja 3, etc.) without prompting for business profile information.
- INDEPENDENT STATION AUTO-UPDATE ARCHITECTURE: Every cashier station and kitchen screen updates its own local disk (C:\Impossible_POS) independently with one click.
- DUAL UPDATER ENGINE: Stations without active local IPC fallback to local service update on 127.0.0.1:3000, ensuring 100% automated local updates without manual steps.
- SILENT AUTOMATIC DRIVER INSTALLATION: digitalpersona_setup.msi installed in background automatically on stations without manual prompts.
- NATIVE BIOMETRIC ENGINE: DPFPBridge.exe and native manufacturer DLLs installed in System_Files and bin, auto-spawned in background.
